cardDesc: Birthday parties with indoor and outdoor space, food and cocktail options, reserved sections, and full or partial buyouts in Mission Beach.
body: Plan a birthday party at Miss B's Coconut Club in Mission Beach with access to the open-air bar, tropical dining room and outdoor patio at 3704 Mission Blvd.
Depending on your group size, event options can include reserved sections, private dining configurations and venue buyouts, with food and cocktail packages planned around the celebration.
